title: PCR Prep and Pooling with 384 Plates - Stage 2
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Add master mix to plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 16 µL of master mix from the reservoir trough to each well of the 384‑well plate, using the same tip for all wells.

steps.title: Multidispense master mix aliquots
steps.instruction: Use the multidispense function: aspirate 8 µL of master mix, then dispense 2 µL into a well four consecutive times (take up 8 µL and dispense 2 µL four times) to maximize dispensing efficiency.

steps.title: Transfer sample to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 2 µL of sample from plate position 9 (PCR 2 pooled plate) to the corresponding well of plate position 8 (PCR 2).
